preview.text: Turn one line ("a turbofan jet engine", "a mechanical watch", "an LVAD heart pump") into a photoreal, physics based, interactive 3D simulation of that machine in a single HTML file, plus a 20 to 30 second film to post it. Real proportions in metres, real materials (PBR metals, paints, polymers, glass), studio lighting with soft shadows, moving parts driven by a small solver that computes real numbers (thrust, torque, rpm, flow, pressure, efficiency), and modes to explode it, cut it open with clean section caps, x-ray it, slow it down, label it and break it. Use this whenever someone asks to build, simulate, visualise, explain or "show how X works" for any machine, engine, mechanism, device, instrument or piece of hardware, wants an interactive 3D model or a cutaway, or wants a video of a machine for a post, even if they never say "simulation" or "three.js".

preview.text: Hunt MFA / 2FA bypass — 7 distinct patterns. Validate: attacker session reaching post-MFA state. Use when hunting auth bypass, MFA flows, chaining primitives toward ATO.

preview.text: Order Executor. Sends approved orders to your broker, paper trading by default, never without your yes. Shows each order as a plain ticket (a bracket shows its stop-loss, take-profit and the max loss at the stop) plus the exact JSON for Alpaca's place_stock_order, records your yes word for word, then Claude's own Allow once / Deny card asks again. Builds the sell ticket that closes a day trade by your flat-by time, records fills, and logs each trade's max loss so trader-risk can hold the daily limit. Use when the user says "place the order", "buy it", "execute", "send it to my broker", "close my position", "flatten", "get me out", "connect Alpaca", "set up paper trading", or after /trader-risk passes.

preview.text: Budget Manager. Sizes every position to your budget and your max loss per trade. preview.text: Exit Planner. Sets your stop and your target before you enter, so you know when to get out. preview.text: Risk Manager. Checks every trade against your limits and stops anything over them, before it can reach the broker. For a day trade: a stop is required, the loss at the stop must fit your max loss per trade (measured from the higher of the plan's entry and a fresh price), reward:risk must meet your minimum, the day's total risk must fit your daily loss limit, no more than your trades per day, and no new entries outside your entry window or when the market is closed. It also keeps the basics: blocked tickers, order size, position cap, cash buffer, margin, short sales, options and crypto, malformed or bad bracket orders, duplicates and a daily order limit. Getting out is never blocked by a day limit. Prints PASS or BLOCK with the reason and records the verdicts so trader-broker only shows an order that passed. Use when the user says "check my order", "is this safe", "risk check", "does this break my rules", "can I take this trade", "how much have I risked today", or before /trader-broker, always.

items.title: story-short-analyze
items.description: 短篇网文拆文。拆解爆款短篇小说（番茄短篇 / 故事会 / 知乎盐言 / 追妻 / 世情 / 重生 / 虐渣等通俗题材）的故事核、结构、情感线、反转设计、写作手法、共鸣层次。单一全量拆解管道：跑完 Stage 2-6 产出完整拆文报告，保存到 拆文库/{书名}/，下游 story-short-write 同时读拆文报告 + 情节节点 + 写作手法 + 原文 + _meta.json 写下一篇。触发方式：/story-short-analyze、/短篇拆文、「拆短篇」「拆这篇短文」「短篇拆文」「精细拆解短篇」「8000 字短篇拆解」「番茄短篇拆文」「故事会拆解」「盐言故事拆解」「分析这篇短篇」——均进入同一管道。
